cards.summary: Defaults.kys id with no menu entry, display name or shortcut in Illustrator 30.2.1. Its four-letter code Txtz is the one Effect > Texture > Texturizer uses (id 'Live PSAdapter_plugin_Txtz'), so this is most likely the Filter-menu Texturizer of Illustrator CS3 and earlier, which applied the Photoshop filter destructively to embedded raster images. Texturizer lays a lit relief texture (brick, burlap, canvas, sandstone or a loaded texture file) over the image. Whether the id still runs on 30.2.1 is unknown.
use_for: recognising the id in an old .kys shortcut set, action or script and mapping it to Effect > Texture > Texturizer
canvas, brick or burlap surface textures on prints and mock-ups, done through the live effect Effect > Texture > Texturizer
avoid: calling it from a script or action: the id was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown (other leftover ids from the same Defaults.kys list, such as Roughen3 and Live PSAdapter_plugin_USMk, raise Error 1200 'BKey')
a painted look: Texturizer only adds surface relief, it does not repaint
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("PSAdapter_plugin_Txtz") is the harvest's invoke string; it was never run on 30.2.1, so whether it still does anything is unknown (other leftover ids from the same Defaults.kys list, such as Roughen3 and Live PSAdapter_plugin_USMk, raise Error 1200 'BKey'). cards.name: Release Planet X
cards.summary: Probably the hidden command id of Object > Live Paint > Release: 'Planet X' is Illustrator's internal name for Live Paint (the harvest pairs Make with 'Make Planet X' by its shortcut and Merge with 'Marge Planet X' by order, neither confirmed by execution), and the harvest's Keyboard Shortcuts alignment pointed at Object/Live Paint/Release, though it could not confirm the pairing. Release turns a selected Live Paint group back into ordinary paths with no fill and a thin black stroke, dropping the painted colours.
use_for: undoing a Live Paint group to get back the plain line work, e.g. to redraw or re-colour it another way
a script step that has to reach Live Paint Release, which has no object-model call
avoid: keeping the painted colours: use Object > Live Paint > Expand, which turns faces and edges into filled and stroked paths
running it without a Live Paint group selected: there is nothing to release
cards.script_api: app.executeMenuCommand("Release Planet X") with a Live Paint group selected (id from Illustrator Defaults.kys; pairing with Object > Live Paint > Release inferred, not confirmed by execution). No object-model call handles Live Paint.

review.changes: summary: the Make/Merge id pairings are inferred in the harvest, now said so
